criteria.statement: schemas/desired_state.json describes desired service, unit-plan, and environment-plan payloads with schema_version 2, UUID fields, hashes, safe secret references, and runtime extensions.
schemas/deployment_unit.json describes persisted deployment units and API deployment-unit requests with runtime, ownership, reconcile, targeting, implicit, and timestamp fields.
schemas/command_receipt.json describes canonical Nostr command receipt fields including request event identity, kinds, idempotency key, status, relay count, timeout, error, retry hint, and message.
schemas/reconcile_policy.json describes environment targeting, deployment-unit reconcile modes, and reconcile state/backoff metadata.
PSTF maturity-slice bundles include acceptance criteria, rollout gates, metrics, rollback criteria, and evidence references for completed maturity dependencies plus Task 14.
Schema and PSTF artifacts are valid JSON and do not alter production code paths.
